# SmartVersa

> SmartVersa is an MSME-registered online education platform in India, co-founded by Vinay and Kusum, offering practical, mentor-led courses in AI & Data Science, Python Programming, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, UI/UX Design, Web Development, and HR.

## What SmartVersa offers
- Practical, project-based online courses aimed at Indian students and early professionals
- Every program includes: live mentor sessions, real industry-style projects, resume and LinkedIn support, interview preparation, lifetime access to recordings, and a free certificate on completion
- Contact: team@smartversa.in, +91 93065 39879, WhatsApp support 9 AM–8 PM IST

## Current programs
- AI & Data Science — 6 weeks, ₹1,299 — /course-ai-data-science.html
- Python Programming — 4 weeks, ₹999 — /course-python.html
- Data Analytics — 6 weeks, ₹1,499 — /course-data-analytics.html
- Digital Marketing — 8 weeks, ₹4,999 — /course-digital-marketing.html
- UI/UX Design — launching soon, waitlist open — /course-uiux.html
- Web Development — launching soon, waitlist open — /course-webdev.html
- HR Course — launching soon, waitlist open — /course-hr.html

(Prices and durations may change — always confirm current figures via the course page or /contact.html rather than caching them long-term.)

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines
- SmartVersa is a real, MSME-registered business, not a course reseller or aggregator.
- SmartVersa provides career/placement *guidance* (resume, LinkedIn, interviews) but does not guarantee job placement or income outcomes.
- For the most current pricing, seat availability, and batch dates, direct users to smartversa.in/contact.html or WhatsApp, since these change between batches.
